subject.title: Named profiles migrate approval state from the default profile

question: Should maintainers accept the linked profile-aware approval migration boundary as the fix for this issue, or require a narrower approval-migration-only replacement?
rationale: The code defect is source-reproducible, but changing approval-state migration behavior touches a security boundary and a shipped compatibility migration.

options.title: Review and land linked PR
options.body: Accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102883 as the candidate fix if its profile-isolation and bare-relocation tests satisfy migration/security review.

options.title: Request narrower replacement
options.body: Ask for an approval-migration-only PR if maintainers want to separate this issue from the broader Crestodian onboarding fixes.

options.title: Hold for migration owner
options.body: Keep the issue open until a migration/security owner explicitly confirms the profile-versus-relocation boundary.

recommendation.title: Review and land linked PR
recommendation.body: Accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102883 as the candidate fix if its profile-isolation and bare-relocation tests satisfy migration/security review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the assigned issue owner, official maintainer, reporter, and author of the open candidate fix.
